topics.topic: Public hearing on Special Town Meeting warrant articles
topics.resolution: hearing held and closed 7:31 p.m.; no vote on the articles recorded
topics.quote: the hearing was to make alterations to code of the town of lunenburg, ma, chapter 250, zoning, article iv use regulations,

topics.resolution: hearing held; Retail Commercial District removed and Village Center District listed
topics.quote: the retail commercial district has not existed since 2017.

topics.topic: Article XX: Water Supply Protection District (§250-4.9)
topics.resolution: hearing held; 2009 aquifer map replaced by July 2021 map
topics.quote: the above article took the map of 2009 and replaced it with the current map of july 2021.

topics.resolution: hearing held; official zoning map changed to November 16, 2021 date
topics.quote: the above article removed the may 3, 2008 zoning map as the official zoning map and replaced it with an official zoning map dated november 16, 2021.

topics.resolution: hearing held; Limited Business/Residential lot area and width defined
topics.quote: limited business/residential was added along with a required lot area of 40,000 sq. ft.
